<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex55102024-09-3016-41-552" status="reviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Post-colophon"/><note type="editorial">In smaller script than the main text and the colophon.</note><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4065">btsun pa zi'u<note type="editorial">For: ze'u</note></rs>s phyag dpe' la bris pa'o ||
         <note type="editorial">Comparing with the colophon of the instance of the <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4967">rNam snang  bsgom thabs</rs>, we take "btsun pa ze'u" to be the scribe, presumably here also <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4065">Ze'u grags shes</rs>, and read "phyag dpe' la" as "phyag dpe' las", presumably indicating the source as being the author's own exemplar.</note> 
         dag go ||</seg></TEI>
